own_solution.law: Young double slit, small angles: y_m = m lambda L / d

notes: y3 = 3 x 600e-9 x 2 / 3e-4 = 0.012 m (12 mm). With L = 2.7 m: 3 x 600e-9 x 2.7 / 3e-4 = 0.0162 m (16.2 mm). T55CC ('then moved') is read as describing the final configuration in which the pattern is observed; a reader could ask whether the question refers to the pattern before the move, but the natural reading is after. The camera's position has no effect on the fringe positions on the screen. T1277 and T68D0 carry 'a small distance' rather than 70 cm; they appear to be numeral-free versions of TE2C3 and TC70F. 0.3 mm/600 nm: theta_3 = 0.006 rad, small-angle fine; still fine at 2.7 m.
